· intro h

    exact LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra_le_ker R L p.ker
  exact Function.Exact.mk h1
· intro h
  have h1 : i.range ≤ p.ker := by
    exact LieHom.map_le_idealRange R L p i.range
    exact LieHom.le_ker_iff R L M p h
  have h2 : p.ker ≤ i.range := by
    rw [LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra_eq_span R L p.ker]
    exact LieIdeal.span_le R L i.range
  exact Eq.trans h1 h2
